description: Stop receiving the given symbols on a channel; the WebSocket stays open for any remaining subscriptions. Returns current connection status. Pair with ws_subscribe; to close the connection entirely use ws_disconnect.

product.description: Channel: cex (crypto), dex (DEX trades), fx (forex), us (US stocks), tvl (DEX pool TVL).

name: ws_unsubscribe
title: Unsubscribe from live stream
